etapes.en: Collocations are words that naturally go together. Natives say « make a decision », not « do a decision »; « heavy rain », not « strong rain ».

exemples.en: make a decision / take a break
exemples.fr: prendre une décision / faire une pause

etapes.en: I came across an old photo of my grandmother
etapes.fr: Je suis tombé sur une vieille photo de ma grand-mère
Je ne supporte plus ce bruit.
reponses: I can't put up with this noise anymore.
I can't put up with this noise any more.
I can no longer put up with this noise.

etapes.en: Let me look into it and get back to you.
choix: Laisse-moi examiner ça et je te recontacte.

etapes.en: We need to come up with a better plan.
etapes.fr: Nous devons trouver un meilleur plan.

resume: Collocations: make a decision, take a break, heavy rain, pay attention. Phrasal verbs: come across, bounce back, figure out, come up with, put up with, run out of.
devoir: Write a paragraph about a difficult moment using 5 phrasal verbs from today.
